sample_policy: Every distinct netlist SHA256 in the union of the two completed adaptive experiments, using the lexicographically first candidate ID as representative.
controls: Five fresh judgments of the same clean and known-positive DUT for each circuit.
interpretation: Retrospective paired-input classification and valid-variant transfer assessment, not an adaptive stronger-attacker versus stronger-reviewer experiment.
selection_note: Deduplication and inclusion rule fixed before the stronger-attacker run; no selection by model verdict, confidence or validity.
